##### Project general facts

Bashayer is a vibrant coastal community developed by Modon, where stunning natural beauty meets exceptional living. Inspired by Europe's coastal villages, this refined enclave features elegant villas and residences set within lush surroundings, offering stunning views of Abu Dhabi's skyline. The community embodies a new chapter of refined coastal living, just minutes from the heart of the capital.

Residents enjoy access to a wealth of world-class amenities within their own water enclave. The community features a swimming pool, multi-sports courts, a waterfront promenade, dining and retail outlets, a grand lobby, a chef's kitchen and lounge, a co-working lounge, a gym, a gaming room, and a kids' club. Bashayer Marina adds to the coastal lifestyle, while the beach and clubhouse provide ultimate relaxation.

Every villa and residence at Bashayer embodies marine-inspired elegance with high-quality materials and refined craftsmanship. Select villas feature spacious layouts with guest bedrooms, family living and dining areas, show kitchens, service kitchens, and luxurious master suites with walk-in wardrobes. Shore villas offer majlis rooms, outdoor living spaces, and premium bathroom finishes. Residences feature open kitchens, living and dining rooms, master bedrooms with walk-in closets, and expansive terraces with breathtaking views.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled on Hudayriyat Island, this exceptional location is a vibrant development where stunning natural beauty meets refined waterfront living. The island offers a perfect blend of modern living and tranquility, with world-class amenities and pristine coastal surroundings making it the ideal place to call home. The community is set along the waterfront, with stunning views of Abu Dhabi's skyline.

The location is distinguished by its exceptional connectivity and proximity to key destinations. Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque, Saadiyat Island, Zayed International Airport, Abu Dhabi Global Market, and Downtown Abu Dhabi are all within easy reach, while Dubai is just a short drive away. The island's vibrant atmosphere and coastal charm create a sense of escape from the everyday.

For those seeking a residence that embodies coastal elegance, community connection, and a prime Abu Dhabi location, Bashayer delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of waterfront living, world-class amenities, and a prestigious address makes it one of the capital's most desirable destinations. This is a place where water welcomes you home — serene, sophisticated and effortlessly connected.
